data.title: The public repository carries the product only: docs/, tasks/, assets/ and the agent tooling stay on disk
data.why: A reader of this repository needs the binary's source, its tests, the agent contract and the journal. docs/ and tasks/ are the owner's working papers — ADRs, design notes, strategy, go-to-market, gate dates, milestone plans — plus four documents whose subject is a person (DEC-19). Splitting either directory would leave dangling links in everything that stayed, so the cut is whole directories. The reasoning a reader still needs does not disappear: it is in this journal, which is committed, and that is the point of the product.
data.rejected: Keep docs/decisions/ and docs/design/ as the useful half — every remaining document links into the other half, and the repository would publish broken links instead of papers; Keep everything and rely on the README to frame it — the working papers outnumbered the product and buried the diff
